audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is transaction gasLimit > 16777216 rejected at txpool admission?

phase1_output.property_assertion: Transaction with gasLimit > 16777216 MUST be rejected at txpool admission
phase1_output.static_analysis: The code explicitly checks `txn.Gas > params.MaxTxnGasLimit` when `isEIP7825` (Osaka fork) is active. MaxTxnGasLimit is defined as 16_777_216 in execution/chain/params/protocol.go:32. The comparison uses strict `>` operator, correctly allowing exactly 16777216 and rejecting 16777217+.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: Path analysis: When isOsaka()=true and txn.Gas=16777217, condition evaluates to true, returning GasLimitTooHigh discard reason.
phase2_output.boundary_conditions: Boundary at 16777216 is correctly implemented with > operator (not >=)
phase2_output.invariant_check: Invariant INV-002 (SG-001, EIP-7825) satisfied: txn.Gas <= MaxTxnGasLimit for all accepted transactions

phase3_output.rationale: The txpool validation correctly implements EIP-7825 gas limit cap. The check is activated for Osaka fork via isEIP7825 flag, uses the correct constant (16_777_216), and employs the correct comparison operator (>). Transaction rejection returns appropriate GasLimitTooHigh reason.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is GAS_CAP constant exactly 16777216 (2^24)?

phase1_output.code_excerpt: MaxTxnGasLimit       uint64 = 16_777_216         // See EIP-7825: Transaction Gas Limit Cap.
phase1_output.property_assertion: GAS_CAP constant MUST equal exactly 16777216 (2^24)
phase1_output.static_analysis: The constant MaxTxnGasLimit is defined as 16_777_216 (using Go's numeric underscore syntax for readability). This equals 2^24 = 16777216. The constant is of type uint64, providing sufficient range.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: N/A - constant value verification

phase3_output.rationale: The GAS_CAP constant is correctly defined as exactly 16777216 (2^24) per EIP-7825 specification. The constant is immutable (Go const) and cannot be modified at runtime.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is tx gas cap independent from block gas limit?

phase1_output.property_assertion: Transaction gas cap (16777216) MUST be enforced independently from block gas limit
phase1_output.static_analysis: Two separate checks exist: (1) txn.Gas > blockGasLimit for block-relative check, (2) txn.Gas > MaxTxnGasLimit for EIP-7825 absolute cap. The EIP-7825 check uses a hardcoded constant, not derived from block gas limit.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: When blockGasLimit=30_000_000 and txn.Gas=20_000_000: First check passes (20M < 30M), second check triggers (20M > 16.7M) when isEIP7825=true
phase2_output.boundary_conditions: EIP-7825 cap is always enforced regardless of block gas limit value
phase2_output.invariant_check: Invariant INV-003 satisfied: MaxTxnGasLimit is independent constant

phase3_output.rationale: The tx gas cap (MaxTxnGasLimit) is a compile-time constant completely independent of block gas limit. Both checks are performed separately, ensuring the EIP-7825 cap cannot be bypassed by a high block gas limit.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does block validation iterate ALL transactions for gas cap check?

phase1_output.property_assertion: Block validation MUST check gas cap for ALL transactions, not just first/last
phase1_output.static_analysis: The preCheck function is called for EVERY transaction during block execution via TransitionDb. The check occurs in the transaction validation phase, which is executed sequentially for each transaction in the block.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: Block with N transactions: preCheck is called N times, once per transaction. Each call independently validates gas limit.
phase2_output.boundary_conditions: No early-exit optimization that would skip validation
phase2_output.invariant_check: Invariant INV-005 satisfied: All transactions in block are validated

phase3_output.rationale: Block validation iterates through ALL transactions via the standard ApplyMessage->preCheck path. Each transaction is independently validated for the gas cap. There is no optimization that would skip transactions or exit early.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is entire block rejected if ANY transaction exceeds gas cap?

phase1_output.property_assertion: Block MUST be completely rejected if ANY transaction exceeds gas cap
phase1_output.static_analysis: When preCheck returns an error, TransitionDb propagates it up. In blockchain.go ExecuteBlock, any transaction error causes the entire block to be rejected. State changes are not committed for invalid blocks.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: Block with 99 valid + 1 invalid tx: Error returned at invalid tx causes entire block rejection
phase2_output.invariant_check: Invariant INV-006 satisfied: Complete block rejection on any invalid tx

phase3_output.rationale: The error returned by preCheck propagates up through TransitionDb and ApplyMessage, causing the entire block execution to fail. There is no code path that would allow partial block acceptance.

audit_items.title: Verify Post-Condition: All transactions in valid blocks have gasLimit <= 16777216?

phase1_output.property_assertion: Post-condition: All transactions in validated blocks have gasLimit <= 16777216
phase1_output.static_analysis: The check in preCheck ensures any transaction with Gas > MaxTxnGasLimit causes block rejection. Therefore, all transactions in successfully validated blocks must have gasLimit <= 16777216.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: By contraposition: If block is valid, then all tx passed preCheck, therefore all tx.Gas <= MaxTxnGasLimit
phase2_output.boundary_conditions: Post-condition holds for all valid blocks

phase3_output.rationale: The pre-condition check in preCheck establishes the post-condition for valid blocks. Any block that passes validation has all transactions satisfying gasLimit <= 16777216.

audit_items.title: Verify Defense-in-Depth: Are both txpool and block validation enforcing gas cap independently?

phase1_output.property_assertion: Defense-in-depth: Both txpool AND block validation MUST independently enforce gas cap
phase1_output.static_analysis: Two independent validation points exist: (1) txpool.validateTx checks before adding to pool, (2) state_transition.preCheck validates during block execution. Both use the same constant MaxTxnGasLimit.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: Path 1: txpool rejects -> tx never in block. Path 2: bypassed txpool, block validation rejects
phase2_output.invariant_check: Invariant INV-007 satisfied: Two independent enforcement points

phase3_output.rationale: Defense-in-depth is implemented with two independent validation layers: txpool admission and block execution. Both check against the same constant (params.MaxTxnGasLimit), providing redundant protection.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: Single source of truth: params.MaxTxnGasLimit used in both locations

phase3_output.rationale: Both validation layers reference the same constant (params.MaxTxnGasLimit) from a single source file. No duplicate definitions or hardcoded values exist that could diverge.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is multiplication_complexity >= 16 for all ModExp inputs?

phase1_output.property_assertion: multiplication_complexity MUST be >= 16 for all ModExp inputs
phase1_output.static_analysis: The function returns either 16 (when x <= 32) or modExpMultComplexityEip2565(x) * 2 (when x > 32). For x > 32, the minimum is when x=33: ceil(33/8)^2 * 2 = 5^2 * 2 = 50 >= 16.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: For x=0: returns 16. For x=32: returns 16. For x=33: returns 50. Minimum is 16.

phase3_output.rationale: The EIP-7883 multiplication complexity formula guarantees a minimum of 16 for all inputs. The small operand case returns exactly 16, and the large operand case returns at least 50.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is multiplication_complexity exactly 16 when max(base_length, modulus_length) <= 32?

phase1_output.property_assertion: multiplication_complexity MUST be exactly 16 when max_length <= 32
phase1_output.static_analysis: When x <= 32, the function returns exactly 16. The condition uses > 32, so x=32 falls into the else branch returning 16.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: For x=1,2,...,32: returns 16. For x=33: returns modExpMultComplexityEip2565(33)*2 = 50
phase2_output.boundary_conditions: Boundary at x=32 correctly returns 16, x=33 returns 50
phase2_output.invariant_check: Invariant INV-002 (EIP-7883) satisfied: mult_complexity == 16 when max_length <= 32

phase3_output.rationale: The implementation exactly matches EIP-7883 specification: multiplication_complexity is exactly 16 for all max_length <= 32 cases.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is multiplication_complexity = 2*ceil(max_length/8)^2 for large operands?

phase1_output.property_assertion: multiplication_complexity = 2*ceil(max_length/8)^2 for max_length > 32
phase1_output.static_analysis: The formula is: (x + 7) / 8 computes ceil(x/8). Squaring gives ceil(x/8)^2. Multiplying by 2 gives 2*ceil(x/8)^2. This exactly matches EIP-7883.

phase2_output.invariant_check: Invariant INV-003 (EIP-7883) satisfied: formula matches spec

phase3_output.rationale: The large operand formula exactly implements 2*ceil(max_length/8)^2 as specified in EIP-7883. The ceiling division is correctly computed.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is iteration_count >= 1 for all non-trivial ModExp inputs?

phase1_output.property_assertion: iteration_count (adjExpLen) MUST be >= 1 for all inputs
phase1_output.static_analysis: The max(_, 1) ensures adjExpLen is at least 1 even when the calculation would produce 0. This prevents zero-cost execution paths.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: For zero exponent: expHeadBits=0, expTailLen=0, adjExpLen=max(0,1)=1
phase2_output.boundary_conditions: Zero exponent case handled by max(_, 1)

phase3_output.rationale: The max(_, 1) clamp ensures iteration_count is always at least 1, preventing zero-cost ModExp execution regardless of exponent value.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is iteration_count exactly 1 for zero exponent with length <= 32?

phase1_output.code_excerpt:

adjExpLen := max(adjExpFactor*uint64(expTailLen)+uint64(expHeadBits), 1)

phase1_output.static_analysis: For zero exponent with expLen <= 32: expTailLen=0, expBitWidth=0, expHeadBits=max(0,1)-1=0, adjExpLen=max(16*0+0,1)=1.

phase2_output.symbolic_execution: Zero exponent (expLen=1,32): expHeadBits=0, adjExpLen=1
phase2_output.invariant_check: Invariant INV-002 (SG-002, EIP-7883) satisfied: iteration_count=1 for zero exp

phase3_output.rationale: Zero exponent with length <= 32 correctly produces iteration_count of exactly 1 due to the max(_, 1) clamp.
